text: Bitcoin's modest 1.6% decline contrasts with Ethereum's sharper 4.6% drop, suggesting traders are rotating toward safer bets within crypto while risk appetite deteriorates. The Fear & Greed index at 28 with a negative 7-day trend confirms sentiment is cooling, though BTC dominance holding above 60% indicates capital isn't fleeing entirely—it's consolidating in the largest asset. Volume of $40B is moderate, pointing to cautious participation rather than panic liquidation.
